target.authentication: per-user Basic username/password plus server-issued short-lived accessToken request header

policy: The fixed Jira Server adapter uses REST API v2 and the company CLI authentication contract. Per-user Basic credentials are encrypted in Connection; the short-lived accessToken is issued and cached by a server-side Token Provider from injected JIRA_TOKEN_* secrets. It does not execute local CLI commands or read CLI config at runtime. Atlassian Cloud OAuth and arbitrary Jira deployment URLs are excluded.
modifications: Replace OpenConnector Jira Cloud site discovery and Cloud OAuth transport with fixed company Jira Server REST API v2.
Move the CLI header command's application token exchange to a server-side, on-demand Token Provider while keeping per-user Basic identity.
Preserve OpenConnector Jira action names and schemas where the Server API supports them.
Add reviewed Server-only issue, workflow, field, user, comment and bulk-create actions; file upload/download are excluded from JSON MCP input until a bounded file contract is approved.
